data.title: Wine cultivar: train and serve
data.summary: The shortest complete loop: read a CSV, train a random forest, score it on held-out data and deploy it as a live endpoint.

sample_dataset.description: 178 wines from three cultivars, 13 chemical measurements each; predict the `cultivar` column.
sample_dataset.source: Wine, UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0

data.title: Thyroid cancer: three-model bake-off
data.summary: Train logistic regression, an SVM and gradient boosting side by side on the same split and compare their test scores.

sample_dataset.description: 383 differentiated thyroid cancer patients followed for at least 10 years, 16 clinical and pathological features (age plus text columns such as stage and treatment response); predict the `recurred` column (yes or no).
sample_dataset.source: Differentiated Thyroid Cancer Recurrence, UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0

data.title: Handwritten digits: image classifier
data.summary: Read a zip of labelled images, train a support vector classifier on their pixels, evaluate it and serve it.

sample_dataset.description: 1,797 handwritten digits as 8x8 greyscale PNGs, one folder per digit 0-9.
sample_dataset.source: Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits, UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0

data.title: Wine: parameterised retrain and redeploy
data.summary: Hyperparameters and the endpoint name are pipeline parameters: change them in Manage Parameters and rerun to retrain and replace the live model.

sample_dataset.description: 178 wines from three cultivars, 13 chemical measurements each; predict the `cultivar` column.
sample_dataset.source: Wine, UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0
